ns2:course.label: Electromagnetic Fields I
ns2:course.description: (PHYCS 335) Concerns static electric and magnetic fields, their interactions with electric charge and current, and their transformation properties; the effect of special relativity is incorporated. Macroscopic fields in material media are described Prerequisite: PHYS 325, MATH 385 or equivalent; credit or concurrent registration in MATH 380, or consent of instructor.
